_readme: What's Good Local weekly deals feed for Oʻahu. Written by the weekly scheduled task; see CLAUDE.md.

deals.name: Bali Oceanfront
deals.deal: $69 three-course prix fixe dinner, 5-6 PM; kids 12 and under eat free with a paying adult
deals.details: First Seating Dinner Special at the Hilton Hawaiian Village restaurant for diners seated between 5 and 6 PM. Kids 12 and under eat free with a paying adult.
deals.location: Waikīkī · Hilton Hawaiian Village, Rainbow Tower, 2005 Kalia Rd

deals.name: Heavenly Island Lifestyle
deals.deal: Happy hour bites from $5.50 fries, $7.50 baked brie, $6 Aloha Blonde draft, 2-4 PM
deals.details: Happy hour menu (last updated Oct 20, 2026) includes guacamole $10.50, garlic shrimp $13 and wings $13.50.

deals.name: Mahina & Sun's
deals.deal: Lanai happy hour: $15 burgers, $12 wings, $12 avocado tacos, $10 hot dog & fries, daily 11:30 AM-5:30 PM
deals.details: Happy hour pricing on the lanai menu at the Surfjack Hotel. The restaurant is cashless.

deals.name: Mahina & Sun's
deals.deal: Sip & Shuck Social: $2 oysters, $5 Maui cans, $8 house bubbles, Mon-Fri 3-5:30 PM
deals.details: Sip & Shuck Social runs Monday through Friday, 3 to 5:30 PM. The restaurant is cashless.

deals.name: Monkeypod Kitchen Waikīkī
deals.deal: Half-off appetizers (seafood excluded) + $17 pizzas, daily 2:30-5 PM and 9-11 PM
deals.details: Happy hour also takes $2 off draft beers, $3 off wines by the glass and $4 off cocktails. Not offered on select holidays.
deals.location: Waikīkī · Outrigger Reef Waikiki Beach Resort

deals.name: Chart House Waikiki
deals.deal: $6 well drinks, $7 draft beers, $10 margaritas and $10 pupus, daily 3:30-6 PM and 9-10:30 PM
deals.details: Sunset and Last Wave happy hours at the bar, dine-in only. Not available on major holidays.

deals.name: Maui Brewing Co. Kailua
deals.deal: $2 off all beers, $3 off MBC craft cocktails, $14 pizzas, 50% off select apps, Mon-Fri 3:30-5:30 PM
deals.details: Happy hour Monday to Friday, 3:30 to 5:30 PM.

deals.name: Maui Brewing Co. Waikīkī
deals.deal: Logo Wear Wednesday: $2 off MBC beers all day when wearing MBC logo gear
deals.details: Wear a Maui Brewing Co. logo shirt or hat on Wednesday for $2 off MBC beers.
deals.location: Waikīkī · Outrigger Waikiki Beachcomber Hotel, 2300 Kalakaua Ave

deals.name: Monkeypod Kitchen Ko Olina
deals.deal: $2 off draft beers, $3 off wine by the glass, $4 off cocktails + half-off appetizers, daily 2:30-5 PM
deals.details: Happy hour also includes $16 pizzas. Seafood appetizers are excluded; not offered on select holidays.

deals.name: Ruth's Chris Steak House Waikiki
deals.deal: Bar happy hour with special cocktails, wine and beer, Mon-Fri 4-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour food is served at the bar only; dine-in only.

deals.name: SKY Waikiki
deals.deal: $4 oysters, $5 Modelo and $10 bubbly, daily 4-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour on the 19th-floor rooftop deck.

deals.name: Tiki's Grill & Bar
deals.deal: Happy hour daily 3-5 PM plus late-night happy hour 10 PM-close on cocktails, beer, wine and pupus
deals.details: Late-night happy hour is dine-in only and offered for a limited time; items include furikake fries, coconut shrimp, lava flows and lychee martinis.

deals.name: TR Fire Grill
deals.deal: $4 Kirin Ichiban draft, $6 Fire Grill mai tai, $5 cabernet, $10 tacos and wings, 3-6 PM
deals.details: Happy hour menu also lists $8 margaritas and $13 shrimp cocktail.

deals.name: Hawaii Nautical
deals.deal: Save 25% on Ko Olina snorkel and sunset sails with promo code SAVE25
deals.details: Limited-time offer listed on the operator's Oahu page; sails depart Ko Olina Marina.

deals.name: Hawaii Shark Encounters
deals.deal: 10% off select morning charters
deals.details: Shark tour operator departing from Haleiwa; the discount is posted on its website.

deals.name: Holokai Catamaran
deals.deal: 15% off snorkel sails with code FALL15, through November
deals.details: Snorkel sails to Turtle Canyon board from Waikiki Beach; check-in is at the Outrigger Reef Waikiki Beach Resort.

deals.name: Kailua Beach Adventures
deals.deal: 15% off self-guided tours and 30% off rentals with a 20-minute beach cleanup (code Beachcleanup)
deals.details: Guests agree to a 20-minute beach cleanup at check-in. Hawaii residents get 25% off with code hawaiiresident and a valid Hawaii ID.

deals.name: Kailua Beach Adventures
deals.deal: Free round-trip Waikiki hotel shuttle on 9 AM guided or self-guided tours booked by Dec 20
deals.details: Booking deadline is December 20 for any future tour date; spots are limited.

deals.name: Ko Olina Ocean Adventures
deals.deal: 10% off any Monday snorkel tour with code MONDAY10
deals.details: Discount is off retail rates for snorkel tours booked for a Monday.

deals.name: Star of Honolulu
deals.deal: Kamaʻāina and military rates on sunset dinner cruises, e.g. Pacific Star Sunset Buffet & Show $103.10 adult (reg. $128.88)
deals.details: Book with promo code resident or military; valid Hawaii or military ID required at check-in. Tax and harbor fee not included.
